# CANDIDATE: STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND_TIME_FILTER

**Filed:** 2026-07-22
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** filter_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Adding a time-of-day filter to the existing structure veto to avoid false signals during low-liquidity or choppy periods (open/close) while preserving the core wrong-trade block during core hours. This aims to reduce losses on marginal loser days without affecting the structure's ability to block losing trades on winner days.

## Mechanism

The existing structure veto (blocks P-in-uptrend / C-in-downtrend) is gated by time: only active between 10:00 ET and 14:00 ET. Outside this window, the veto is disabled. Entry logic remains unchanged; only the veto condition is time-filtered.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline
2. **Sample bias:** Building on STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND (16-month OPRA sample, n=~600 trades). Adding time filter introduces one new parameter (start/end times). Overfit risk mitigated by using conventional market hours (10:00-14:00) motivated by observed liquidity/structure patterns. Sample size unchanged but parameter space increased.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window not yet performed)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (real OPRA validation on top 3 J days pending)
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: Strong trending market outside 10:00-14:00 where veto is disabled, leading to unblocked wrong-way trades and increased losses (e.g., gap-and-go days).
   - Max drawdown: Unknown without backtest; hypothesized to be similar or slightly better than base structure veto due to reduced false signals.
   - Blow-up scenario: Persistent regime where >70% of structural signals occur outside 10:00-14:00, causing veto to be mostly disabled and losing its protective effect.
6. **Concentration:** Assuming similar to base candidate (STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND showed no concentration flags in leaderboard); top-5 days likely <30% of P&L based on veto's broad applicability.
